title: Worker screens die with the app; a terminal worker's Claude outlives it
notes: A terminal worker runs in the pane host's shell and keeps working through an app restart. A worker screen's Claude is a child of the app, so a restart ends the turn it was in; it comes back on its conversation (checked on the --screen trial) but only carries on from the next prompt. One of the two things that block making --screen the default (workers-decision-5).
